mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_agent_capability_mount_sets(tenant_id,agent_id,generation) SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,1 FROM public.nw_agents a WHERE a.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND a.id::text=#{agent} ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,agent_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT generation FROM public.nw_agent_capability_mount_sets WHERE tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND agent_id::text=#{agent} FOR UPDATE

WITH mount_source AS (
SELECT (item->>'mount_id')::bigint AS id, #{tenant}::bigint AS tenant_id, #{agent}::bigint AS agent_id, item->'capability'->>'type' AS capability_type, (item->'capability'->>'capability_id')::bigint AS capability_definition_id, (item->'capability'->>'version_id')::bigint AS capability_version_id, (item->>'priority')::integer AS priority, (item->>'revision')::bigint AS revision, item->'config'->>'activation_mode' AS activation_mode, (item->'config'->>'token_budget')::bigint AS token_budget, (SELECT td.id FROM public.nw_tool_deployments td WHERE td.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND td.deployment_key=item->'config'->>'tool_deployment_id') AS tool_deployment_id, (item->'config'->>'tool_deployment_revision')::bigint AS tool_deployment_revision, (item->'config'->>'workflow_instance_id')::bigint AS workflow_instance_id, (item->'config'->>'workflow_instance_revision')::bigint AS workflow_instance_revision, (item->'config'->>'installation_revision')::bigint AS workflow_installation_revision, item->'config'->>'mode' AS knowledge_binding_mode, (item->'config'->>'pinned_revision_id')::bigint AS knowledge_pinned_revision_id, CASE WHEN (item->>'active')::boolean THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{frozenMember} AS jsonb)->'mounts'->'mounts') item
SELECT id,tenant_id,agent_id,capability_type,capability_definition_id, capability_version_id,priority,status,revision,created_at, updated_at,activation_mode,token_budget,tool_deployment_id,tool_deployment_revision, workflow_instance_id,workflow_instance_revision,knowledge_binding_mode,knowledge_pinned_revision_id,workflow_installation_revision FROM public.nw_agent_capability_mounts
) SELECT m.id::text AS mount_id,m.revision,m.priority,m.capability_type,m.capability_definition_id::text AS capability_id, CASE WHEN m.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' THEN kv.id ELSE mv.id END::text AS version_id,
CASE WHEN m.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' THEN kv.descriptor || jsonb_build_object('name',kv.name,'description',kv.description) WHEN m.capability_type='WORKFLOW' THEN mv.descriptor || jsonb_build_object('name',mv.name,'description',mv.description) ELSE mv.descriptor END::text AS descriptor, CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND m.capability_type='SKILL' THEN mv.descriptor->>'activation_mode' ELSE m.activation_mode END AS activation_mode, m.token_budget,d.provider_type AS provider_type,d.provider_ref AS provider_ref,d.deployment_key AS deployment_id, CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN d.revision ELSE m.tool_deployment_revision END AS deployment_revision, wi.id::text AS instance_id,wv.id AS instance_revision, CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN wi.installation_revision ELSE m.workflow_installation_revision END AS installation_revision, kr.kb_id::text AS knowledge_id,kr.revision AS knowledge_revision,kr.id::text AS knowledge_revision_id, COALESCE(cd.status='PUBLISHED' AND cd.capability_type=m.capability_type AND (cd.tenant_id IS NULL OR cd.tenant_id=m.tenant_id) AND mv.status='PUBLISHED' AND mv.definition_id=cd.id AND mv.capability_type=m.capability_type AND (mv.tenant_id IS NULL OR mv.tenant_id=m.tenant_id) AND CASE m.capability_type WHEN 'SKILL' THEN mv.descriptor->>'activation_mode' IN ('ALWAYS','ON_DEMAND') AND m.token_budget>0 AND (#{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR m.activation_mode = mv.descriptor->>'activation_mode') WHEN 'TOOL' THEN d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.provider_type IN #{provider} AND (#{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR d.revision>=m.tool_deployment_revision) AND dv.definition_id=mv.definition_id AND jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'input_schema')='object' AND (NOT jsonb_exists(mv.descriptor,'output_schema') OR jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'output_schema')='object') AND jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'model_invocable')='boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'confirmation_policy')='string' AND mv.descriptor->>'confirmation_policy' IN ('NEVER','POLICY','ALWAYS') AND (NOT jsonb_exists(mv.descriptor,'sensitive_fields') OR jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'sensitive_fields') IN ('null','array')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'sensitive_fields')='array' THEN mv.descriptor->'sensitive_fields' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' OR btrim(item#>>'{}')='' OR item#>>'{}'<>btrim(item#>>'{}')) AND (NOT jsonb_exists(mv.descriptor,'provider_requirements') OR jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'provider_requirements') IN ('null','array')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'provider_requirements')='array' THEN mv.descriptor->'provider_requirements' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) item WHERE jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' OR btrim(item#>>'{}')='' OR item#>>'{}'<>btrim(item#>>'{}')) WHEN 'WORKFLOW' THEN wi.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND wi.status='published' AND wv.capability_version_id=mv.id AND wir.installation_revision>0 AND wc.status NOT IN ('archived','disabled') WHEN 'KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' THEN kb.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND kb.status='active' AND kr.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND kr.status='published' AND kr.published_at IS NOT NULL AND kv.definition_id=cd.id AND kv.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' AND kv.status='PUBLISHED' AND kv.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND (m.knowledge_binding_mode='FOLLOW_ACTIVE' OR (m.knowledge_binding_mode='PINNED_REVISION' AND kr.capability_version_id=mv.id)) ELSE false END,false) AS valid, (mv.descriptor->'input_schema')::text AS input_schema, COALESCE(mv.descriptor->'output_schema','{}'::jsonb)::text AS output_schema, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'model_invocable')='boolean' THEN (mv.descriptor->>'model_invocable')::boolean END AS model_invocable, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'confirmation_policy')='string' THEN mv.descriptor->>'confirmation_policy' END AS confirmation_policy, jsonb_exists(mv.descriptor,'output_schema') AS output_schema_declared, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'sensitive_fields')='array' THEN mv.descriptor->'sensitive_fields' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS sensitive_fields, (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(octet_length(convert_to(value,'UTF8'))::text||':'||value,'' ORDER BY convert_to(value,'UTF8')),'') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'provider_requirements')='array' THEN mv.descriptor->'provider_requirements' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) elements(value)) unique_elements) AS provider_requirements, mv.descriptor->>'effect' AS effect, CASE WHEN m.capability_type='TOOL' AND jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'idempotent')='boolean' THEN (mv.descriptor->>'idempotent')::boolean END AS idempotent, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mv.descriptor->'timeout_ms')='number' THEN (mv.descriptor->>'timeout_ms')::bigint END AS timeout_ms, NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(mv.descriptor->>'tool_name', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(ci.capabilities)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(ci.capabilities)=1 THEN ci.capabilities->>0 END)),'') AS tool_name, (SELECT string_agg(v, ',' ORDER BY v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(kr.source_versions, '[]'::jsonb)) v) AS source_versions, (SELECT string_agg(v, ',' ORDER BY v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(kv.descriptor->'allowed_operators', '[]'::jsonb)) v) AS allowed_operators FROM mount_source m LEFT JOIN public.nw_capability_definitions cd ON cd.id=m.capability_definition_id
LEFT JOIN public.nw_capability_versions mv ON mv.id=CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND m.capability_type<>'SKILL' THEN cd.default_version_id ELSE m.capability_version_id END LEFT JOIN public.nw_tool_deployments d ON m.capability_type='TOOL' AND d.id=m.tool_deployment_id AND d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_capability_versions dv ON dv.id=d.tool_version_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_connector_instances ci ON m.capability_type='TOOL' AND ci.instance_id=d.provider_ref AND ci.tenant_id=d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_workflow_instances wi ON m.capability_type='WORKFLOW' AND wi.id=m.workflow_instance_id AND wi.tenant_id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_workflow_installation_revisions wir ON wir.instance_id=wi.id AND wir.tenant_id=wi.tenant_id AND wir.installation_revision=CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN wi.installation_revision ELSE m.workflow_installation_revision END LEFT JOIN public.nw_workflow_definition_versions wa ON wa.id=wir.definition_version_id AND wa.tenant_id=wi.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_workflow_containers wc ON wc.id=wa.container_id AND wc.tenant_id=wi.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_workflow_definition_versions wv ON wv.container_id=wc.id AND wv.tenant_id=wi.tenant_id AND wv.id=CASE WHEN #{frozenMember,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN wc.active_definition_version_id ELSE m.workflow_instance_revision END LEFT JOIN public.nw_knowledge_bases kb ON m.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' AND kb.id::text=mv.descriptor->>'source_id' AND kb.tenant_id=m.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_knowledge_base_revisions kr ON kr.kb_id=kb.id AND kr.tenant_id=kb.tenant_id AND kr.id=CASE WHEN m.knowledge_binding_mode='FOLLOW_ACTIVE' THEN kb.active_revision_id ELSE m.knowledge_pinned_revision_id END LEFT JOIN public.nw_capability_versions kv ON kv.id=kr.capability_version_id WHERE m.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND m.agent_id::text=#{agent} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.capability_type IN #{capabilityType} ORDER BY m.priority DESC,m.id
